title: WLED + Hyperion: ambilight without the price tag

intro.headline: Ambient backlight. Without the $250 box.
intro.subhead: An ESP32, a cheap addressable LED strip, and open-source software recreate Hue-style screen sync for a fraction of the cost.

outro.headline: Build once, enjoy forever.
outro.subhead: WLED and Hyperion turn a $20 board and a strip of LEDs into a zero-latency ambilight setup. What are you lighting up first?
